units.source_text: 且说以前向玉鬘夫人家大女公子求婚的人，后来个个升官晋爵，可当东床之选者不乏其人。

en.t: As for the men who had once sought the hand of Lady Tamakazura's eldest daughter, they had all later risen in rank and office, and there was no shortage among them of suitable sons-in-law.

units.source_text: 其中被称为源侍从的薰君，当年还是一个弱龄童子，现在已当宰相中将，与匂皇子并称于世，即所谓“匂亲王、薰中将”是也。

en.t: Among them, Lord Kaoru, who had been called the Genji Chamberlain, was still only a young boy in those days, but now he had become a Counselor Middle Captain and was celebrated alongside Prince Niou, the pair known to the world as Prince Niou and Captain Kaoru.

units.source_text: 其人也的确生得端庄稳重，温文尔雅。

en.t: He was indeed handsome in a dignified and composed way, with a gentle and refined manner.

units.source_text: 许多身份高贵的亲王、大臣都想把女儿嫁给他，但他概不允诺，至今还是独身。

en.t: Many high-ranking princes and ministers wished to marry their daughters to him, but he accepted none of them and remains unmarried to this day.

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人常说：“此人当时幼稚无知，想不到长大起来如此聪明俊秀。”

en.t: Lady Tamakazura often said, "He was so childish and ignorant then; who would have thought he would grow up to be so intelligent and handsome?"

units.source_text: 还有当时的藏人少将，现在也已升任三位中将，声名卓著。

en.t: The Chamberlain Lesser Captain of those days had also now been promoted to Third Rank Middle Captain and enjoyed an outstanding reputation.

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人身边几个性情稍稍浮薄的侍女悄悄地议论：“此人从小就连相貌也是很漂亮的。”

en.t: A few somewhat frivolous ladies-in-waiting around Lady Tamakazura whispered among themselves, "Even as a child, he was beautiful in appearance."

units.source_text: 又说：“到宫中去受气，还不如嫁了此人。”

en.t: They also said, "Rather than go to court and suffer humiliation, she would have been better off marrying him."

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人听了这种话，心中很难过。

en.t: When Lady Tamakazura heard such talk, she felt deeply distressed.

units.source_text: 这中将对玉鬘夫人家大女公子的恋情，至今还不断绝，一直埋怨玉鬘夫人冷酷无情。

en.t: This Middle Captain's love for Lady Tamakazura's eldest daughter had still not faded, and he continued to resent Lady Tamakazura for being cold and heartless.

units.source_text: 他娶了竹河左大臣家的女公子为妻，然而一向不爱她。

en.t: He had taken a daughter of the Takekawa Left Minister as his wife, yet he had never loved her.

units.source_text: 手头戏书的，口上惯说的，都是“东路尽头常陆带”之歌。

en.t: What he idly wrote with his hand and habitually murmured with his lips was always the poem of the Hitachi sash at the far end of the eastern road.
No one knew what he was planning in his heart.

units.source_text: 大女公子在冷泉院当皇妃，不胜烦恼，常常归宁在家。

en.t: The eldest daughter, serving as an imperial consort at Reizei-in, was overwhelmed with troubles and often returned to her family home.

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人看到她的生涯不能如意称心，深感遗憾。

en.t: Seeing that her daughter's life could not unfold as happily as she had wished, Lady Tamakazura felt profound regret.

units.source_text: 入宫当尚侍的二女公子，倒很光荣幸福，人都称道她知情达理，可敬可爱，生涯十分安乐。

en.t: The second daughter, who entered the palace as Naishi no Kami, by contrast enjoyed honor and happiness; everyone praised her as sensible, worthy of respect, and lovable, and her life was very peaceful.
